function: Excluded as above_phy: the learned agent chooses UAV flight (angle, speed, altitude) and the traffic offloading share, with fixed transmit power, so no physical-layer function (p. 5).
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Reason above_phy: the action space is the UAV flight and the offloaded share of traffic, p. 5: "Action decisions include UAV flight decisions and the task size of handling traffic offloading". Transmit powers are fixed inputs in Table I (p. 4). Federated learning averages model weights digitally at the leader UAV (p. 7-8), and CPRAFT is a leader-election consensus (p. 8). No channel estimation, detection, beamforming or power control is learned. Table I of p. 4 was read from the page image.
